title: Count the items in the cart
ticket: The cart badge says "023" items when I only have five things in my cart.
hints: Look at the line that adds each item's quantity to the running count. What type is `qty` in the cart data?
The quantities arrive from the API as strings. When either side of `+` is a string, JavaScript joins text instead of adding numbers.
Convert the quantity before adding it: `count += Number(item.qty);`
theory: The `+` operator does two jobs: if either operand is a string, it concatenates; otherwise it adds. JSON from APIs often carries numbers as strings ("2" rather than 2), especially for money and quantities, so `0 + "2" + "3"` becomes "023". Convert at the boundary with `Number()` (or `parseInt` for whole numbers) as soon as the data arrives, and when a number looks wrong, check `typeof` before suspecting the maths.
